# NitroSQLite

> SQLite for React Native on iOS and Android, built with Nitro Modules.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs): Installation, native setup, and a first query.
- [API reference](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/api): Public methods and types.
- [AI coding agents](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/guides/ai-agents): Skill link and checks for generated code.
- [NitroSQLite skill](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-skills/blob/nitro-sqlite/skills/react-native-nitro-sqlite/SKILL.md): Task-specific guidance and references.
